QuestInfo.name: [Pet] A Demon of a Deal
QuestInfo.0: Metus, the demon of death, has an offer so good, you won't have the willpower to resist. If you don't at least hear him out, he'll be very, VERY disappointed.
QuestInfo.1: Listen to what Metus, the demon of death, has to offer. He swears on your life that you won't regret it.
QuestInfo.2: You've discovered the benefits of the Demon's Heinous Pact. Whether it ends up costing your soul remains to be seen...
